name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: `Existence(at_exit)` only requires reaching the exit; it does not require carrying the box there. The task says to carry the box to the exit, so add hard `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` alongside the hard `Existence(at_exit)`. Keep the hard `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)` for the next-move pickup requirement.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` does not require carrying the box at the exit; it allows picking it up later. The task says to carry the box to the exit, so require `holding_box` at `at_exit` (for example, `Response(holding_box, at_exit)` would not express that either). Keep `Existence(at_exit)` and the hard `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)`, and replace the Response clause with a requirement that the box is held when reaching the exit.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The task says to carry the box to the exit, but hard Existence(at_exit) only requires reaching the exit; it does not require holding_box there. Add a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) to require carrying the box on the exit step. Keep the hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), which correctly requires pickup on the very next step after each fall.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) and Response(at_exit, holding_box) require reaching the exit while carrying the box; ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking it up on the very next step after each fall.

texts: Reach the exit while carrying the box.
Be carrying the box when reaching the exit.
Whenever the box falls, carry it again on the very next step.
